name: Seaside Way
desc1: The western wall of Arlysia is much shorter than the other walls.  It
desc2: was built this way, so that in more prosperous times, the wealthy ship
desc3: owners could look out their top windows and see the boats in dock, and
desc4: look out over Crystal Lake.  With the recent problems, there is much
desc5: regret and paranoia over the wall, and the guard is normally doubled
desc6: on this side.  Partially in protection of the city, and partially to
desc7: keep an eye on those brave souls still willing to work the waters.
